description: Re-ingest an already-managed project: reconcile or repair existing .aidd metadata (stale contract artifacts) and then re-run the metadata-only project-intake pipeline, refreshing artifacts without duplicating existing features. Intake ends by parking open features for approval, so a re-intake also moves this project's existing backlog and in-progress features back to waiting_approval.
name: project-reintake

configJson.prompt: Reconcile this project's .aidd metadata before re-ingestion. Inspect what already exists and repair it in place: (1) if .aidd/ holds artifacts that do not match the current contract shape, refresh them without discarding still-valid content; (2) leave the .aidd/features/ inventory on disk complete and accurate, because the later feature-generation step reads those records itself to decide what is already covered and refresh rather than duplicate it — nothing from this step's own output is forwarded into the nested intake recipe. Do not delete legitimate existing features, and write nothing outside .aidd/.
